info.title: com.clodhub/member-pricing
info.description: Member prices: plans that give their members a percentage off, fixed prices for some items, or both. Staff open a sign-up session for a plan and share its link; the person gives a name and email; staff approve, and the member gets a voucher whose code gives the plan's prices. The price rules are pure and the same in the browser and on the server; the server keeps plans, sessions and vouchers in a records store (com.clodhub/records) and draws codes from voucher codes (com.clodhub/voucher-codes). Amounts are integers in minor units. Emails are the application's.

methods.name: isEligible
methods.description: Whether a member with this rule has the item at a member price; true for everyone when there is no rule. Custom and mixed plans cover exactly the items in itemPricing; discount plans all items, the items named or the items of the categories named.

params.name: rule
params.description: The member's rule; null for everyone else.

methods.name: isFixedPrice
methods.description: Whether the item has a fixed member price: every item of a custom plan, the items of a mixed plan priced with type fixed.

params.name: rule
params.description: The member's rule; null for everyone else.

methods.name: discountPercentFor
methods.description: The member's percentage off the item: a discount plan's for covered items, a mixed plan's discount entry for the item; null otherwise.

params.name: rule
params.description: The member's rule; null for everyone else.

methods.name: applyDiscount
methods.description: The price less the percentage, rounded half up to the minor unit.

schema.description: An amount in the currency's minor unit (cents for EUR).
An amount in the currency's minor unit (cents for EUR).

methods.name: resolveItemPrice
methods.description: The price charged for one item at the requested length, the same on the reserve page and the server: a fixed price sells only its own length (and a custom plan nothing it does not price); otherwise the catalogue option of that length, less the member's discount where one applies. Null when the item is not sold at that length.

params.name: rule
params.description: The member's rule; null for everyone else.

price.description: An amount in the currency's minor unit (cents for EUR).

methods.name: validatePlanInput
methods.description: Checks a plan from the owner's form and gives the plan to store, or the first problem as a code with an English description. Custom and mixed plans get itemSlugs from itemPricing, no categories, allItems false and discountPercent 0; custom entries are fixed prices; mixed discount entries carry minutes and price 0.

params.name: settings
params.description: The installed settings by default.

error.description: What is wrong, in English, naming the item.

methods.name: expiryFrom
methods.description: When a voucher issued at from stops: amount weeks, calendar months or years later, in UTC; a day the target month lacks becomes its last day.

schema.description: A JavaScript Date; shown here as its ISO 8601 text.
A JavaScript Date; shown here as its ISO 8601 text.

methods.name: normaliseEmail

methods.name: settingsFrom

error.description: What is wrong, in English, naming the item.

params.name: planId

methods.name: MemberPricing.setPlanActive
methods.description: Switches a plan on or off; only an active plan opens sign-up sessions. An active that is not a boolean is MISSING_FIELDS.

params.name: planId
params.description: A plan's _id; anything else is NOT_FOUND.

methods.name: MemberPricing.openSession
methods.description: Opens a sign-up session for an active plan; the application shares its link (or a QR code of it). It lasts sessionMinutes.

params.name: planId
params.description: A plan's _id; anything else is NOT_FOUND.

expiresAt.description: A JavaScript Date; shown here as its ISO 8601 text.

methods.name: MemberPricing.submitSession
methods.description: The person's name (1 to 100 characters) and email on the sign-up page; the session then waits for staff. A missing or unknown language becomes en. Name and email are checked before the session.

params.name: sessionId
params.description: The id openSession gave.

methods.name: MemberPricing.session
methods.description: What the sign-up page and the staff page show while they wait; null when there is no such session or it has expired.

params.name: sessionId
params.description: The id openSession gave.

methods.name: MemberPricing.approve
methods.description: Issues the member's voucher from a session waiting for staff: a new code (drawn again when taken), the plan's rule, expiry from the plan's validity. Once only. The application then sends the member the code.

params.name: sessionId
params.description: The id openSession gave.

methods.name: MemberPricing.validate
methods.description: What the reserve page asks before showing member prices. An active voucher past its expiry is marked expired.

params.name: code
params.description: A code as typed or pasted; voucher codes' normalise reads it.

methods.name: MemberPricing.lookup
methods.description: A voucher for staff, with an active one past its expiry marked expired; null when there is none.

params.name: code
params.description: A code as typed or pasted; voucher codes' normalise reads it.

methods.name: MemberPricing.revoke
methods.description: Revokes a voucher; it no longer validates.

params.name: code
params.description: A code as typed or pasted; voucher codes' normalise reads it.

methods.name: MemberPricing.remove
methods.description: Deletes a voucher and returns it for the removal email: notify is true when it was not revoked, and expired says whether it had expired.

params.name: code
params.description: A code as typed or pasted; voucher codes' normalise reads it.

methods.name: MemberPricing.changeEmail
methods.description: Changes where the code is sent, before the application sends it again; plan is null when the plan was removed.

params.name: code
params.description: A code as typed or pasted; voucher codes' normalise reads it.

methods.name: MemberPricing.vouchersOf
methods.description: A plan's vouchers, newest first, with lapsed ones marked expired.

params.name: planId
params.description: A plan's _id; anything else is NOT_FOUND.

methods.name: MemberPricing.vouchersByEmail
methods.description: The vouchers issued to an address, newest first (by issuedAt, then _id), with lapsed ones marked expired; revoked ones are included with their status. The address is read as normaliseEmail reads it, and text that is not an address gives []. For a customer's wallet: the application confirms the address (com.clodhub/email-verification) first.

methods.name: MemberPricing.resolveItemPrice
methods.description: resolveItemPrice itself, for a caller that receives only this object, such as reservations: it prices each line with activeRule's rule.

price.description: An amount in the currency's minor unit (cents for EUR).

methods.description: The rule the server prices a booking with: null unless the voucher is active and unexpired.
